---
description: 'Add a new agent pattern to the pattern library: canonical diagnostic answers, narrative, typical platforms and a golden scenario.'
argument-hint: 'Pattern name and a one-sentence description'
agent: 'agent'
---

Add a new pattern (a common type of agent) to the pattern library. Follow [the content rules](../instructions/content.instructions.md).

If `content/patterns.yaml` or `content/questions.yaml` does not exist yet, stop and say so: the pattern library is built after the first phases. If the name, description or signature answers are missing, ask for them before continuing.

1. Add the pattern to `content/patterns.yaml`: a kebab-case `id`, a title, a one-sentence summary, a short narrative, and the canonical answers keyed by question id. Use only option values that exist in `content/questions.yaml`. Always answer `accessModel` (delegated, own-teammate, own-background or mixed): the scenario card and brief show it as how the agent acts. Set `reviewStatus: draft`.
2. Do not edit the Pattern × Capability matrix. It is generated by running the rule engine on each pattern, so it stays consistent with the rules.
3. Add a golden scenario to `content/golden-scenarios.yaml` for the pattern, with `mustInclude` (the capabilities that must be Essential) and `mustNotInclude`. Author the expectations from the rules, not from what the engine returns. Leave `reviewedBy` and `reviewedOn` empty. An unreviewed scenario produces a warning, not a failure.
4. Check that who to license reads sensibly: `licensing.basis` comes from `mapping.yaml` `licenseBasis` for the `accessModel` answer, and a pattern that leaves it unanswered shows the "confirm with your Microsoft account team" text instead. Add a test if you add a way of acting.
5. Add a [changelog](../../content/changelog.md) entry. Its `affects:` line lists the capability ids that now appear for the pattern.
6. Run `npm run content:build`, `npm test` and `npm run lint`, and fix any failure.
7. Summarize the canonical answers you chose, the resulting Essential capabilities, and anything marked `TODO(verify)`.
